worldcombat.skill.attract.summary: Throw a flying kiss at a single foe: on hit it is infatuated for a while, may lose its nerve each time it tries to act, and is kept on a tether — stray too far and it is reeled back. Pokemon must be the opposite gender.
worldcombat.skill.attract.description.0: On hit, infatuate for %2$s s: each time the target tries to act it has a %1$s%% chance to lose its nerve and be pulled about %3$s blocks toward you (lighter targets move farther).
worldcombat.skill.attract.description.1: The kiss flies at about %2$s blocks/tick with a radius of about %1$s blocks: cover can block it, but it slowly homes in. While infatuated it is reeled back whenever it gets farther than %3$s blocks, and breaking line of sight lets it slip free. Pokemon must be the opposite gender; vanilla mobs, modded mobs and players have no gender, so they are charmed directly.
worldcombat.skill.attract.allure.0: Allure: a slightly lower chance to lose nerve and a longer cooldown, but a longer infatuation and a longer pull, made to stall.
worldcombat.skill.attract.allure.1: Sweet talk: a higher chance to lose nerve and a shorter cooldown, but a shorter infatuation and a shorter pull, made to interrupt now.
worldcombat.skill.attract.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks. After %2$s s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to throw the kiss, recovers %3$s s, and commits a %5$s s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.attract.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.attract.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.attract.preference.all: On = Allure: -8% lose-nerve chance, +14 ticks cooldown, but +80 ticks infatuation and a x1.35 pull. Off = Sweet talk: +8% chance, -14 ticks cooldown, -30 ticks infatuation. Each direction pays a price.
The companion only throws the kiss while a threat is within this distance; lower throws up close, higher lets it open from range.
On "meet the attack", the companion waits until the foe is attacking it or its owner before throwing, reading like a counter-charm when pressed.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to throw a kiss at a threat within range.
On, the companion only throws a kiss at a fleeing threat, using it as a way to hold a runner; off, it charms any threat within range.
